items.text: Lamar Jackson listed IN with no designation and expected to play vs Bills after missing three games with ankle injury; full participant.
items.why: No injury designation; coach confirmation of play; full practice.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; boosts associated pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share return for QB1 and targets to Flowers etc.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed IN with no injury designation for SNF vs Commanders after hamstring/back concerns; good to go.
items.implication: Full RB1 workload expected despite prior uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and three-down role intact; reverse any backup bumps.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka ruled OUT (concussion/foot) for second straight week vs Falcons.
items.why: Did not clear protocol/foot issue; official out list.
items.implication: TB WR targets redistribute; sit Egbuka.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining Bucs pass-catchers.

items.text: Carnell Tate OUT (shoulder) vs Bengals; no practice this week.
items.implication: TEN WR depth thins; targets to others.
items.opportunity: Potential bump for remaining Titans receivers.

items.text: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) both OUT vs Commanders; week-to-week.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets consolidate to remaining options including Goedert.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Dallas Goedert and other PHI WRs.

items.text: RJ Harvey OUT (knee) vs Chiefs; added mid-week and no practice Friday.
items.why: Knee; ruled out on final report.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry bump for J.K. Dobbins and/or Jonah Coleman.

items.text: Trade rumors surrounding Breece Hall; also listed questionable again with quad. Unclear meaning of his faith post.
items.why: Rumors + repeated Q designation; player social post ambiguous.
items.implication: Monitor closely for status and long-term value; potential sell or hold depending on outcome.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Allen handcuff spikes; usage data key if plays.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) again this week; monitor for game-time.
items.implication: Risky start; Braelon Allen elevated if inactive.
items.opportunity: If OUT, full backfield opportunity for Allen; if IN, shared.

items.text: After two-TD outing, sell high on Quinshon Judkins; role hit with Dylan Sampson return (season-low snaps/targets last week).
items.why: Sampson return crushed Judkins target share to 3% and snaps to 51.5%; passing-game role diminished.
items.implication: Trade now while value high post-TDs; reduced ceiling going forward.
items.opportunity: Majority touches remain but pass-game opportunity lost.

items.text: ETR has taken Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot), Carnell Tate (shoulder), Tyjae Spears (knee), and AJ Brown (knee) out of projections; view fallout at link.
items.why: Injury statuses solidified; projections adjusted for zero contribution.
items.implication: Immediate sit; check handcuffs and teammate target bumps in ETR projs.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups and remaining WRs/RBs on TEN/NE/TB.

items.text: Josh Jacobs following Ashton Jeanty path of strong fantasy value via high-value touches: 3 carries inside-5 and 13 targets in two games since suspension. Efficiency bonus if it comes.
items.why: Inside-5 carries + target volume driving fantasy production despite efficiency questions.
items.implication: Start with confidence as RB1/2; parallel to Jeanty as volume asset.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and receiving work secure high floor/ceiling.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE as WR5 this week; Lamar Jackson return unlocks him (targeted on 48% of routes previously with Lamar). Track-meet Bills-Ravens expected.
items.why: Lamar back; elite prior target rate on routes; high-scoring matchup.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; elevate in rankings.
items.opportunity: High route participation and target share with Lamar.

items.text: Jaylen Waddle HATE this week (WR30); production lacking and Chiefs have allowed just one TD to opposing WR all season (to JSN).
items.why: Tough matchup vs KC secondary; recent poor production; also Q with chest.
items.implication: Sit if possible; low floor in bad spot.
items.opportunity: Limited expected targets/routes vs elite coverage.

items.text: Brian Thomas Jr. projected in Konata Mumpfield/Troy Franklin tier for Week 8 after 87-1282-10 rookie season; major drop 20 games later.
items.why: Current projections reflect diminished role/efficiency vs rookie breakout.
items.implication: Fringe/startable only in deep leagues; sell or sit if better options.
items.opportunity: Low projected routes/targets relative to prior.
